value.interfacePart: Make the brush thicker and add a red colour.

value.reason: A thicker brush and a red colour option need changes to the tool's controls and code, and a change to how it looks can't do that. For now, you can drag the Size slider up to 40 and pick red with the Color control.

value.summary: The brush is thicker: it starts at 8 and can go up to 80. A new Red button picks red with one click.
